classification: CURRENT UNFIXED BOOKWORM PACKAGE / CONDITIONAL LOCAL RISK
executionReview: PAM 1.5.2-6+deb12u2 is installed. Debian reports its previous fix was not applied correctly. pam_namespace requires a local-user path/symlink/race condition. No active pam_namespace line was found in /etc/pam.d of either exact affected image; frontend UID 1000 and PostgreSQL UID 999 were verified. This does not prove arbitrary native/operator/compromised-container paths safe.
requiredMitigations: Keep the local synthetic scope, non-root users, read-only runtime, dropped capabilities and no-new-privileges.
Do not introduce PAM authentication, namespace configurations, untrusted shell accounts or user-controlled privileged paths without reassessment.
Recheck for a Bookworm security backport before any later release; no Trixie migration or source-built PAM substitution is authorized by this review.
